hooks.command: p=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null); case "$p" in *.env|*.env.*|*/.env|.env) echo 'BLOCKED: writes to .env are denied per permission-matrix.md S6 (default-deny secrets).' >&2; exit 1;; esac

c=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("command",""))' 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]][^;&|]*\breset\b[^;&|]*--hard|(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]][^;&|]*\bpush\b[^;&|]*(--force|--force-with-lease|-f([[:space:]]|$)|[[:space:]]\+)|(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]][^;&|]*\bclean\b[^;&|]*-[a-z]*f|(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]][^;&|]*\bcheckout\b[^;&|]*([[:space:]]--([[:space:]]|$)|[[:space:]]\.([[:space:]]|$))|(^|[;&|[:space:]])rm[[:space:]]+(-[a-zA-Z]*[rR][a-zA-Z]*[fF]|-[a-zA-Z]*[fF][a-zA-Z]*[rR])'; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command (C.9, permission-matrix.md S6). Escalate to the owner instead.' >&2; exit 1; elif printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]][^;&|]*\brestore\b' && ! printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '\-\-staged'; then echo 'BLOCKED: `git restore` without --staged discards uncommitted work (permission-matrix.md S5). Revert in place, or use --staged to unstage only.' >&2; exit 1; elif printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]][^;&|]*\bpush\b[^;&|]*([[:space:]]|:)(main|master|trunk)([[:space:]]|$)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: the agent never pushes the protected branch (AGENTS.md S3). Push YOUR branch and open a draft PR; a human marks it ready and merges.' >&2; exit 1; fi

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && set -o pipefail; make gate 2>&1 | tee -a .claude/last-check.log; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'POST-EDIT GATE: make gate GREEN'; else echo "POST-EDIT GATE: make gate FAILED (exit $rc) -- fix before the next edit" >&2; exit 1; fi
